queries_run: SharkNinja China tariff Vietnam sourcing 2026 earnings

findings.claim: 10-K 稱美國貿易政策變動（進口關稅）已對公司造成並預期持續造成重大不利影響；大部分產品在中國、越南等美國以外地區製造；2026-02-20 最高法院裁定推翻部分 IEEPA 關稅，政府宣布以其他法律徵收新關稅
findings.excerpt: Significant changes to U.S. trade policies that restrict imports or increase import tariffs and the responses of other countries have had, and we will expect will continue to have, a material adverse effect on our business.

findings.claim: 10-K：大部分產品在中國、越南等美國以外地區製造，美國政策使取得海外製品更困難或更昂貴，已影響並可能持續影響銷售與獲利
findings.excerpt: A significant proportion of our products are manufactured in China, Vietnam and other regions outside of the United States. Accordingly, such U.S. policy changes have made it, and may continue to make it, difficult or more expensive for us to obtain certain products manufactured outside the United States, which have affected and could continue to affect our net sales and profitability.

findings.claim: 10-K：公司認為產品不受近期出口管制措施直接影響，但不排除對貨源取得有間接負面影響；亦提及供應商可能被列入 BIS Entity List 的風險
findings.excerpt: We do not believe our products are directly impacted by these recent measures, but we cannot rule out the possibility that these measures could have an indirect negative impact on our business and our ability to source certain products from key jurisdictions.

findings.claim: Q3 2026 指引假設中國、越南、泰國關稅 12.5%，印尼、馬來西亞、柬埔寨 10%；IEEPA 退稅申請約 $247.1M 獲 CBP 接受，預計列為銷貨成本減項

reg_tariff_export.note: Q3 2026 8-K 與 10-Q（指引假設中國／越南／泰國 12.5%、印尼／馬來西亞／柬埔寨 10%；IEEPA 退稅申請約 $247.1M 已獲 CBP 接受，列為銷貨成本減項）僅見搜尋摘要，未讀頁面，列入 clues。Section 232 未見公司直接量化。 線索 1 條，程式核實 0 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
